summary.headline: Senior Front-End Engineer with 7+ years building financial platforms, data visualization tools, interactive documentation, and AI-powered applications.
summary.tagline: Specialized in Svelte, React, and TypeScript — focused on performance, accessibility, scalable component architecture, and AI-driven development with Agents, MCP, RAG, and Context Engineering.

soft_skills: Delivering high value balancing quality and delivery cycles with excellent time management
Problem-solving and critical thinking, optimizing systems and addressing complex challenges
Knowledge sharing through code reviews, documentation, and pair programming
Highly adaptable in remote teams, consistently meeting deadlines and achieving business objectives

expertise: Continuously update technical knowledge to stay at the forefront of modern development practices.
Proven ability to bridge communication between technical teams and stakeholders, ensuring seamless project delivery.
Extensive experience in developing PWAs and reusable component libraries, streamlining the development of new products.
Building AI Agents and automated workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery cycles by 60–90%.
Designing and developing MCP Servers and MCP Clients to give LLMs structured access to project context, reducing AI hallucination and prompt slop.
Implementing RAG pipelines with embedding models and vector databases to enable accurate, context-aware AI responses.
Applying Context Engineering techniques to manage token budgets, memory, and retrieval strategies across multi-step AI workflows.
Creating production-ready AI Chatbots integrated into front-end applications with streaming, history, and grounding via RAG.
Fine-tuning LLMs and building embedding pipelines for domain-specific search, classification, and recommendations.

highlights.text: Mentor Jr. developers in acquiring new knowledge, applying methodologies, critical thinking, and effective AI usage.
Develop AI workflows to automate code review, task management, metrics, and granular context control.
Built AI agents for pre-analysis of project bugs, TDD planning and E2E testing — reducing test elaboration and debug time by 60%.
Built screen annotation tools with COCO-format annotations for AI agent training, UI creation with assertive prompts and task planning — reducing planning time by 90%.
Developed MCP Servers with project instructions, component context, libraries, design tokens and screens — responsible for reducing AI Slop in initial prompts.
Refactoring legacy architecture areas in projects to reduce unreadable code and optimize features.
Building complex components using LLMs and MCP Clients (Claude Code, Cline, etc).
Led the development of an MVP to manage bank accounts, investments, and company ownership using Svelte, TypeScript, SCSS, Tailwind, Vite, DevContainer, and Jest — reducing lifecycle issues by 90%.

Delivered a PWA for managing expenses, transfers, and property investments using Svelte, TypeScript, SCSS, Tailwind, Vite, Playwright, and Jest — reducing app loading times by 40% via Lazy Loading and code splitting.
Designed and implemented a component library using Svelte, Tailwind, Vite, Jest, and Storybook — decreasing sprint development time by 70%.
Implemented endpoint documentation components using Svelte, TypeScript, SCSS, Tailwind, Storybook, Vite, and Markdown — outperforming Docusaurus + React.
Spearheaded an interactive documentation platform with microfrontend approach using React, Docusaurus, Widdershins, Webpack, Svelte, TypeScript, and PostCSS.

Built a high-performance PWA for managing credit cards, points, payments, and budget groups using Svelte, TypeScript, SCSS, Tailwind, Vite, and Storybook — reducing sprint time by 70% with a custom component library over Material-UI.

Refactored the static documentation platform using Svelte, Vite, TypeScript, PostCSS, and Tailwind to process OpenAPI spec files — reducing first load by 60% and script execution from 11s to 1s via SSR and Lazy Loading.

Built an SSR documentation app with Svelte, Qwik, React, and Astro to benchmark performance, state management, and bundle size — capable of generating static pages with CRUD components from a JSON file.
Created an NPM Package with core static documentation features reusable across React, Vue.js, Svelte, and Angular — built with Vite, TypeScript, Jest, and Salt-DS.
Maintained and improved embedded systems for payment devices.
Leveraged Svelte, JavaScript, and Docker to deliver scalable platform applications, reducing small screen issues by 70%.
Built landing pages for BTG Pactual using React, Redux, Gatsby, Styled Components, and TypeScript.
Developed PWAs for visualizing public and private data trends using React, Redux, Styled Components, D3 Charts, and a full CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins.
Developed a Node.js and MongoDB API to fetch and return data trends.
Built a discount coupon app focused on data collection and insights for industry partners using React, Next.js, and Styled Components.
Built a design system improving development time by 40% using React, TypeScript, Storybook, Figma, and Jest.
Designed and implemented custom WordPress and Moodle themes and plugins.
